summary: Attempt 1 discarded. The pre-registration stands and is not re-registered. Blocked on the gateway serving the model the record names.
why: The 0.30 arm was 35 trials in when a probe of the gateway returned HTTP 200 for a request naming 'claude-haiku-4-5' and an answer from 'gemini-3.1-pro-preview'. The record says claude-haiku-4-5, and the entire point of Task 37 is that it is the same model Task 36 ran.

The run was discarded because the RECORD would have been false, not because the results looked wrong: the agent had found the planted edge on trial 0 at +9.8190, the oracle's score to four decimals, and the running best had reached +29.39.

How much of the run was affected cannot be established. Call recorded tokens, latency and errors; it did not record which model answered. That gap is now closed by Call.model_served, drain_log()['models_served'], ModelSubstituted and LLMAgent.preflight().
pre_registration_note: Budget, q, strengths, template digest and model were all correct and committed before any trial ran. Re-registering after seeing 35 trials is the pattern this project spends most of its effort avoiding, so the record stands and only the run was thrown away.
blocked_on: the gateway serving 'claude-haiku-4-5'. Last checked 2026-09-16 during Task 46: 503 upstream. claude-sonnet-5 and claude-fable-5-1 returned 403 at the proxy and gemini-3.6-flash 503, so no substitute was available either -- and a substitute is not what this arm needs.
not_abandoned_because: d607d42 records 'The campaign resumes when it is not [503]'. Marking this abandoned would assert that the pre-registration is spent, which no one has decided. If that IS the decision, set status to 'abandoned' and say who decided and when -- the field exists for it.
